title: BeatsSnapshot
description: Canonical snapshot of a deterministic beats track: the minimal (genre, seed, structure) definition that fully determines the render, as JSON-LD. Its CID (sha2-256 of the JCS bytes, CIDv1 dag-json, base58btc) is the track's stable identity. Snapshots are not signed and are not owned: anyone can compute one. They are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 and carry that license in-band, so the dedication travels with every copy.

license.description: CC0 1.0 Universal public domain dedication (SPDX: CC0-1.0).

x-license.scope: the snapshot document and the (genre, seed, structure) definition it records
